video_title: 'You CANNOT COUNT on Kawhi Leonard' 😳 + Where does OKC go from here? | NBA Today

quotes.speaker: Shams Charania
quotes.summary_phrase: Kawhi Leonard to miss weeks due to left knee swelling
quotes.excerpt: Kawhi Leonard will be out for a period of weeks dealing with this swelling in his left knee.
quotes.quote: Kawhi Leonard will be out for a period of weeks dealing with this swelling in his left knee. An MRI showed no ligament damage, there was no structural issue with that left knee, so that's the good news. But now the Raptors and Kawhi Leonard, just a week into the regular season, are opting to choose time for him to rehab and ramp back up here in the coming weeks.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Raptors cannot rely on Kawhi Leonard as a superstar
quotes.excerpt: You cannot count on Kawhi Leonard. He is an unreliable superstar.
quotes.quote: It's a bummer, but it's not surprising. You get why they trade for Kawhi Leonard. It raises the ceiling where you can squint and see the Raptors being legitimate contenders, but the problem is you cannot count on Kawhi Leonard. He is an unreliable superstar, and that's why there is so much risk in the trade and in the $115 million extension.

quotes.speaker: Shams Charania
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Williams and Cason Wallace facing extended recovery time
quotes.excerpt: The Thunder are going to be braced for both players potentially out for the rest of the season.
quotes.quote: It will be surgery for both Jalen Williams as well as Cason Wallace, and the Thunder are going to be braced for both players potentially out for the rest of the season. These are several months of rehab that goes into both the dislocated ankle as well as the fractured fibula for Jalen Williams, and for Cason Wallace, a torn labrum. Cason Wallace is expected to be out up to six months potentially.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Thunder depth depleted by injuries to key defensive wings
quotes.excerpt: That's three all-defensive wings that they've lost.
quotes.quote: Their depth has really been depleted between the series of cost-cutting moves that they made this summer to obviously these injuries. And if you think about it, Lou Dort's gone, not coming back. Jalen Williams, Cason Wallace potentially out for the season. That's three all-defensive wings that they've lost. They plug in Jared McCain and Ajay Mitchell in the starting lineup, but Sam Presti has to figure out are there moves he can make to help now while he's balancing the long-term view in a really tight financial picture.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Cason Wallace and Jalen Williams provide critical defensive pressure
quotes.excerpt: Cason Wallace comes out there and he defends, Jalen Williams defends.
quotes.quote: Cason Wallace comes out there and he defends, Jalen Williams defends. We look at the OKC Thunder and say, hey, every year they're up to touch, they're going to pressure the ball, they take away that first pass and pressure the ball all the time, all the games. So when you look at it and say these guys are out, you don't want to have that drop-off. Those guys, Ajay Mitchell, I'm not saying he's a bad defender, I'm just saying he's not Cason Wallace. He's not able to match up with guys that have a little bit of height to him.

quotes.speaker: Chiney Ogwumike
quotes.summary_phrase: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander is built to carry the Thunder's load
quotes.excerpt: Shai is built to withstand taking on more of a load.
quotes.quote: They've lost some really key players for them, but they still have SGA, who is the reigning MVP. And more often than not, people look at people in these circumstances where their usage is up or down, and you're like, oh, can they withstand this? I think Shai is built to withstand taking on more of a load. Just by the way he approaches a game, he is never too high, never too low.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Thunder maintain elite rim protection with Holmgren and Hartenstein
quotes.excerpt: The one thing they still have, more so than ever, is elite rim protection.
quotes.quote: The one thing they still have, more so than ever, is elite rim protection. You start Isaiah Hartenstein next to Chet Holmgren, those are two outstanding rim protectors. And Aday Mara, man, looks like they've got another one, 7-foot-3, and he's making an impact already as a rookie.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander provides steady leadership for young Thunder team
quotes.excerpt: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander is as even-keel and steady of a leader as there is in the NBA.
quotes.quote: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander is as even-keel and steady of a leader as there is in the NBA. Sam Presti in the GM spot, same thing, Mark Daigneault. This is not a team that gets caught up in a whole lot of big-picture discussions and philosophical, there's not a roller coaster team. Their thing is, hey, we're going to deal with the human element, our teammates, our friends, our guys we love are down, we're going to deal with the human element, but we've got to move forward.
